r to Mr. Vijender Katoch, Advocate.

Jyotsna Rewal Dua, Judge Petitioner, presently in custody, as an accused in FIR No.270/2018 dated 26.10.2018, registered under Sections 341, 323, 504, 382, 376-D and 201 of the Indian Penal Code at Police Station Manali, District Kullu H.P., is seeking regular bail under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

entities.text: Police Station Manali, District Kullu H.P.
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the petitioner seeks leave to withdraw the present petition with liberty to approach the learned trial Court at the first instance.
Prayer being innocuous has not been opposed by learned Additional Advocate General.
Accordingly, the petition stands dismissed as withdrawn with leave and liberty as

Whether reporters of the local papers may be allowed to see the judgment?
prayed for.
Pending miscellaneous application(s), if any, shall also stand disposed of.

.
 Jyotsna Rewal Dua  Judge  22nd May 2023 (rohit)
